c-mod-space-moderation.8.expected: test_moderator opening Help Desk /mod/ gets 'You do not have permission to moderate this space.' or 404

With a true space-only moderator (alice given the moderator role in Bug Reports for the check, then restored) Help Desk /mod/ reads 'You do not have permission to moderate this space.' and Bug Reports opens. The fixture description (moderator of Bug Reports and Moderators' Room only) is wrong.

c-mod-space-moderation.9.actual: As test_moderator the call returned 200 and trashed Help Desk topic 5806 (restored straight away through moderation approve; the author got two moderator notices).
